scripts.text: Hi there! I am the AI Front Desk for CloseDesk, powered by Aicyro.
We seamlessly integrate with GoHighLevel, HubSpot, Zapier, and Salesforce via Webhooks.
Whether you need HVAC maintenance, plumbing repairs, or electrical work, I can get you scheduled.
The Starter plan is 97 dollars a month, and the Pro plan is 297 dollars a month.
